title: Stalled image safety checks now time out
summary:
Image requests got timeouts for stalled safety checks and stopped waiting on telemetry, while queue and cache limits were adjusted and partly rolled back.

Flux Kontext prompt and input-image safety checks now return a timeout error after 30 seconds instead of leaving requests waiting indefinitely. The input-image timeout was added after an initial 20-second prompt timeout, which was then raised to 30 seconds.

A tighter anonymous image queue limit was added, then reverted: anonymous and registered requests can each use up to five queue slots. The image cache limit was raised to 500,000 entries, replacing the 20,000-entry limit and eviction logic added earlier in the day.

Image telemetry now runs in the background rather than making requests wait for Tinybird. Cached-image requests no longer look up an external provider for each hit; analytics records `cloudflare-cache` instead. Provider lookups elsewhere moved to the shared registry, which now lists flux, kontext, turbo, and gptimage as the configured image models.
